summary: This bill requires the Department of Health and Human Services to revise federal workplace drug testing guidelines to include methadone and to annually review and update the list of tested substances, and subsequently requires the Department of Transportation to update its drug testing regulations for transportation employees to include methadone and any newly identified substances.

scores.thoughts: The bill mandates revisions to federal workplace drug testing programs and Department of Transportation drug tests to include methadone, and requires annual reviews and updates. These actions would incur administrative costs for the relevant agencies, leading to a minor increase in government spending.
